editorNote.label: EDITOR'S NOTE
editorNote.title: How we read numbers
editorNote.text: Prioritize verified context over quick news and verifiable records over assertions. Track where raw materials come from, what stages prices are attached to, and how regulations are translated between paper and field. The starting point of reporting is always sentences from the scene.
